framing-correction.issue: RoflLens 0.1.0 adds relative param bytes unsigned; negative signed deltas fabricate entity IDs offset by multiples of 256.
framing-correction.fix: Repository adapter reads signed int8 deltas, preserves uint32 wrapping, updates framing state before packet filtering, and resets state per chunk. RoflLens remains the container/decompression dependency.
framing-correction.consequence: This invalidates some entity classifications and historical candidate counts, not the prior packet boundary counts. No model comparisons had been admitted.

method.acquisition: Riot Match-v5 replay URLs; signed downloads without API token. Full Match and Timeline responses retained privately.
method.matching-inputs: Exact build, signed-URL match ID, duration within 3 seconds, full champion/team/KDA roster, and timeline/match participant identities checked. ROFL PUUID-like strings are not assumed to be API PUUIDs.
method.discovery: First replay identified opcode 421 as death timing/victim and opcode 810 as skill-upgrade timing/actor. Whole-payload skill labels learned only from uniquely time-aligned discovery events.
method.holdout: Death profile was frozen before processing the unseen Summoner’s Rift replay. Skill codebook was learned solely from the first replay, frozen before its held-out skill check, and not expanded from held-out labels.
method.runtime: Recovery reads replay and exact-build profile only. Optional Match/Timeline inputs are used after recovery solely for validation. Unknown skill payloads abstain.
method.skill-limit: The 37-entry codebook matches entire payloads; it is an empirical subset, not a complete bit-level layout or rank decoder.

validation.scope: Death timestamp and victim only; killer, assists, damage, and combat model unchecked

skill-upgrades.scope: Timestamp, actor, skill slot and upgrade type for known whole-payload patterns only; no rank or cast decoding

validation.scope: Death timestamp and victim only; killer, assists, damage, and combat model unchecked

unsupported-mode-check.result: Rejected: recovery requires ten distinct champion/team pairs
unsupported-mode-check.note: An unsupported Arena sample was downloaded before its mode was known; included in cost accounting.

coverage.limits: One discovery and one held-out Summoner’s Rift game, one exact build. No aggregate model accuracy percentage. No killer, assist, item ID, champion level, pre-hit stats, cast or damage decoding claimed.

additional-available-anchors.limits: Minute/frame state samples and death recap rows are API observations. They are not exact pre-hit state or time-stamped individual replay damage events.

negative-results.item-events: Opcode 63 overlaps 144/146 purchases but emits 186 records; transformations and other inventory activity unresolved. No complete inventory or item IDs admitted.
negative-results.level-events: No complete champion-level stream identified by the discovery timing/actor check. Skill upgrades are not champion level-ups.
negative-results.simple-death-killer-byte: Byte-at-fixed-offset lookup has conflicting discovery labels; rejected rather than transferred from older patches.

cost.scope: Replay recovery times exclude acquisition, repeated development scans, API history search, dependencies and researcher time. This investigation also downloaded one unsupported Arena replay.

next-step: Expand current-build skill/inventory recovery on discovery games while reserving fresh held-out games, then reconstruct exact pre-hit state for independently attributable damage. Keep historical completeness deferred.
